messages:
emily: starting a quick sync — partner ask: hardware SI needs an offline OTLP-only collector for airgapped demos; wants a single tarball + install script. can we scope that?

dan: short answer: yes. propose opentelemetry-collector binary + small wrapper that points to a local file sink, and an optional uploader tool for post-demo.

tomek: for marketplace demos we also need a datadog-side receiver config so the upload maps to the right org + env tags. i'll draft a mapping table.

sara: marketing wants 2 screenshots: the datadog trace explorer with our tag and a dashboard with latency histogram. we need deterministic traces. can we ship a seed script?

dan: will add seed_traces.sh that replays sanitized traces from jsonl. keeps it safe for screenshots. usage: ./seed_traces.sh demo-traces.jsonl --rate 50

emily: legal note: no PII, embargo until joint announcement. sara — loop in legal for signoff on assets.

tomek: ops note: airgapped bundle will include certs generator and K8s manifests for an offline namespace. also an uninstall target.

sara: timeline check — partner briefing next Wed, we need first pass artifacts by Mon COB. doable?

dan: yes. i'll have collector binary + seed script by Mon.

tomek: i'll post the datadog mapping + dashboard JSON by Mon as well.

emily: ops-bot create doc at https://redwood-internal/partnerships/otel-offline-bundle and calendar "OTEL Offline Bundle Review" for Mon 3pm PT. invite partner PMs.

ops-bot: created doc https://redwood-internal/partnerships/otel-offline-bundle and calendar event for Mon 15:00-16:00 PT. edit access: emily, dan, tomek, sara. :white_check_mark: 

sara: small perf ask — can we ensure exporter can handle a burst of 5k spans without backlog for the demo? add perf smoke test to runbook.

dan: will include perf test: `go test ./perf -run PerfBurst -args -spans=5000 -workers=8`

emily: perfect. action owners: dan=bundle & seed script, tomek=datadog mapping & dashboard, sara=assets & legal, emily=partner coord. post any showstoppers in the doc under DAY-OF RISKS. thanks all. :rocket:
